1: Allah, paak hai Woh, har us cheez se buland hai jo Us ke laayak nahin. Wohi hai jo apne bande Muhammad ﷺ ko raat ke waqt Masjid-e-Haram se, jo Makkah mein hai, Bait-ul-Maqdis ki masjid tak le gaya, jis ke aas-paas ko Maine phal, kheti aur nabiyon (alaihimus salaam) ke thikanon se barkat di, taake woh unhein apni kuch nishaniyan dikhaye jo Allah ki qudrat aur Us ki taaqat batati hain, paak hai Woh. Wohi hai jo har cheez sunta hai, koi aawaz Us se nahin bachti, aur Wohi hai jo har cheez dekhta hai, Us se koi dikhayi dene wali cheez chhipi nahin.
2: Aur Maine Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko Taurat di aur use Bani Israel ke liye hidayat aur rehnumai banaya. Aur Maine Bani Israel se kaha: Mere siwa koi kaar-saaz na banao jis ke hawale tum apne kaam karo. Balke sirf Mujh par bharosa rakho.
3: Tum un logon ki nasl se ho jin par Maine ehsan kiya aur unhein Nooh (alaihis salaam) ke saath toofan mein doobne se bacha liya. Lihaza is naimat ko yaad karo aur sirf Allah ki ibadat aur Us ki itaat karke Us ka shukr ada karo. Aur is mein Nooh ka namoona apnao, kyunke woh Allah ka bahut shukr ada karne wale the.
4: Aur Maine Bani Israel se kaha aur unhein Taurat mein bata diya ke woh apne gunah aur apne gurur se zameen mein do baar zaroor fasaad machayenge, aur woh logon par zulm aur zyadati ke saath buland honge aur apne is uthne mein hadein phaand jayenge.
5: Phir jab pehla fasaad hua, to Maine un par apne woh bande musallat kar diye jo bari taaqat aur bade zor wale the, jinhon ne unhein qatl kiya aur unhein bay-ghar kar diya. Unhon ne un ke ghar luut liye aur jahan se guzre har cheez tabah kar di. Aur Allah ka is ka wada zaroor poora hua.
6: Phir Maine ek baar aur tumhein, aey Bani Israel, un logon par qaaboo aur ghalba diya jo tum par musallat kiye gaye the, jab tum ne Allah ki taraf tauba ki. Aur Maine tumhein tumhara maal luut liye jaane ke baad maal diya, aur tumhari aulaad qaid kar liye jaane ke baad aulaad di, aur Maine tumhein tumhare dushmanon se zyada tadaad wala giroh bana diya.
7: Aey Bani Israel, agar tum achhe kaam karo jaisa tum se chaha gaya hai, to us ka badla tumhare hi faide mein hoga, kyunke Allah tumhare aamaal ka mohtaaj nahin. Aur agar tum bure kaam karo to us ka anjaam bhi tumhare hi nuqsan mein hoga. Tumhari nekiyan Allah ko faida nahin deteen aur tumhari buraiyan Use nuqsan nahin pahunchateen. Phir jab doosra fasaad hoga to Main tum par tumhare dushman musallat kar doonga taake woh tumhein zaleel karein aur tumhare chehron par us zillat ki wajah se sharmindagi zaahir ho jo woh tumhein chakhayenge, aur taake woh Bait-ul-Maqdis mein daakhil hon aur use tabah karein jaise woh pehli baar daakhil hue aur use tabah kiya, aur taake woh un tamam ilaaqon ko poori tarah barbaad kar dein jinhein woh fatah karein.
8: Aey Bani Israel, ho sakta hai ke tumhara Rubb is sakht badle ke baad tum par reham kare agar tum Us ki taraf tauba karo aur neik kaam karo. Magar agar tum teesri baar ya us se bhi zyada fasaad ki taraf laut jao, to Main bhi tum se badla lene ki taraf laut aaoonga. Aur Maine Jahannam ko kafiron ke liye ek qaid-khana bana diya hai jis se unhein koi chhutkara na milega.
9: Yeh Quran, jo Muhammad ﷺ par utara gaya, sab se behtar raaste ki hidayat deta hai, jo Islam ka raasta hai, aur woh un logon ko aisi khabar deta hai jo Allah par iman rakhte hain aur neik kaam karte hain, jo unhein khush kar degi: ke unhein Allah ki taraf se bada ajr milega.
10: Aur woh un logon ko aisi khabar deta hai jo Qayamat ke din par iman nahin rakhte, jo unhein dukh degi: ke Maine un ke liye Qayamat ke din dardnaak azaab tayyar kar rakha hai.
11: Aur insaan apni na-waaqfiyat ki wajah se apne aap ke liye, apni aulaad ke liye aur apne maal ke liye burai ki dua karta hai jab woh gusse mein hota hai, jaise woh apne liye bhalai ki dua karta hai. Agar Hum us ki burai ki dua qabool kar lete to woh barbaad ho jata, aur us ki aulaad aur us ka maal bhi. Aur insaan apni fitrat mein jaldbaaz hai, is liye woh jaldi mein aisi cheez laa sakta hai jo us ke liye nuqsan-deh ho.
12: Aur Maine raat aur din ko do nishaniyan bana kar paida kiya jo Allah ke yakta hone aur Us ki qudrat ko batati hain, un ke farq ki wajah se ke woh lambe hote hain ya chhote, garam hote hain ya thande. Maine raat ko aaram aur neend ke liye andheri banaya aur din ko roshan banaya jis mein log dekh sakein aur apni rozi ke liye kaam karein. Yeh is liye hai ke din aur raat ke badalne se tum saalon ki ginti jaan sako aur un maheenon, dinon aur ghanton ka hisaab kar sako jin ki tumhein zaroorat hai. Aur Maine har cheez tafseel se khol kar bayan ki hai taake sab kuch saaf ho jaye aur sachche jhooton se alag ho jayein.
13: Aur Maine har shaks ke liye us ke aamaal use is tarah laga diye hain jaise haar gale se laga hota hai. Woh us se juda nahin honge jab tak un ka us se hisaab na le liya jaye. Aur Qayamat ke din Main us ke liye ek kitab nikaaloonga jis mein us ki har achhi ya buri harkat hogi, aur woh use apne saamne khuli hui paayega.
14: Aur Main us din us se kahunga: aey insaan, apni kitab padh aur apne aamaal par apni jaan ka hisaab kar le. Qayamat ke din apna hisaab lene ke liye tu khud kaafi hai.
15: Jo shaks iman ki hidayat paata hai, us ke hidayat paane ka ajr usi ki apni bhalai ke liye hai; aur jo bhatak jata hai, us ke bhatakne ki saza usi ke nuqsan mein hai. Aur koi jaan kisi doosri jaan ka gunah nahin uthati, aur Main kisi qaum ko us waqt tak azaab nahin deta jab tak un ki taraf rasool bhej kar un par hujjat qayam na kar doon.
16: Aur jab Main kisi basti ko us ke zulm ki wajah se halak karne ka faisla karta hoon, to Main un logon ko, jo faraakhi ki wajah se be-parwah ho gaye, Allah ki itaat ka hukm deta hoon magar woh nahin maante. Balke woh Us ki nafarmani karte hain aur hadein phaand jate hain, to un par mitane wale azaab ki baat sachi ho jati hai aur Main unhein poori tarah halak kar deta hoon.
17: Aur Hum ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ke baad bahut si nasleein halak kein, jaise Aad aur Samood. Aur aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb apne bandon ke gunahon ko jaanne aur dekhne ke liye kaafi hai. Us se kuch chhipa nahin aur Woh unhein un ka badla dega.
18: Jo shaks apni neki ke kaamon se duniya ki zindagi chahta hai aur Aakhirat par iman nahin rakhta aur us par koi dhyaan nahin deta, Main us ke liye woh aish jald kar deta hoon jo Main use dena chahta hoon, woh nahin jo woh chahta hai. Phir Maine us ke liye Jahannam bana rakhi hai, jis mein woh Qayamat ke din daakhil hoga aur us ki tapish sahega, apne duniya ko chunne aur Aakhirat ko jhutlane par malaamat-zada aur Allah ki rehmat se nikaala hua.
19: Aur jo shaks apni neki ke kaamon se Aakhirat ka ajr chahta hai, aur us ke liye waisi hi koshish karta hai jaisi karni chahiye, dikhawe aur naam ki chaahat se paak ho kar, jab ke woh us par iman rakhta hai jis par iman laana Allah ne farz kiya: in sifaat wale logon ki koshish Allah qabool karega aur unhein us ka badla dega.
20: Aur aey Rasool, in dono giroh ko, yani gunahgaron aur parhezgaaron ko, Hum aap ke Rubb ki ata khule haathon dete hain. Duniya mein aap ke Rubb ki ata kisi se nahin roki jati, chahe woh gunahgaar ho ya parhezgaar.
21: Aey Rasool, gaur kijiye ke Hum ne duniya mein rozi aur darje ke lihaz se kuch ko doosron par kaise fauqiyat di. Aur Aakhirat mein naimat ke darjon ka farq duniya ke farq se kahin bada hai, aur us ki naimatein bhi bari hain, lihaza momin ko usi ka khwahishmand hona chahiye.
22: Aey bande, Allah ke saath koi doosra maabood na bana jis ki tu ibadat kare, warna tu Allah aur Us ke neik bandon ki nazar mein malaamat-zada ho jayega aur Us ki taraf se chhod diya jayega.
23: Aey bande, tere Rubb ne hukm diya aur farz kiya hai ke tu Us ke siwa kisi ki ibadat na kare, aur Us ne hukm diya hai ke tu apne maa-baap ke saath achha sulook kare, khaas kar jab woh boorhe ho jayein. Phir agar un mein se ek ya dono tere paas boorhape ko pahunch jayein, to un se aise lafz keh kar apni jhunjhlahat zaahir na kar, unhein na daant, aur un se baat karte waqt sakhti na kar, balke un se narm aur adab wali meethi baat kar.
24: Aur un ke saamne aajizi aur shafqat se jhuk ja, aur keh: aey mere Rubb, in par reham farma jaisa inhon ne mujhe bachpan mein pala.
25: Aey logo, tumhara Rubb khoob jaanta hai jo tumhare andar hai: ibadat mein Us ke liye khulus, neki ke kaam aur maa-baap se achha sulook. Phir agar tumhari ibadat, apne maa-baap ke saath tumhare sulook aur baaqi kaamon mein tumhari niyat neik hai, to Woh, paak hai Woh, un logon ke liye Bakhshne wala hai jo baar baar tauba karke Us ki taraf rujoo karte hain. Jo shaks apne Rubb ki ya apne maa-baap ki itaat mein apni pichli kotahi se tauba kare, Allah use maaf kar dega.
26: Aey momin, rishtedaar ko us ka haqq do, rishta jod kar; aur gareeb aur mohtaaj ko do; aur us musafir ko do jo raaste mein phans jaye. Aur apna maal gunah mein ya fizool tareeqe se kharch na karo.
27: Jo log apna maal gunah mein kharch karte hain aur jo apne kharch mein fizool-kharchi karte hain, woh shaytanon ke bhai hain: woh un ke fizool-kharchi aur hadd se barhne ke hukm par chalte hain. Aur shaytan hamesha apne Rubb ka na-shukra hai, woh sirf gunah ke kaam karta hai aur sirf us baat ka hukm deta hai jo us ke Rubb ko na-pasand hai.
28: Aur agar tum in logon ko dene se ruko, is wajah se ke tumhare paas unhein dene ko kuch nahin aur tum Allah se rozi ki naimat ke muntazir ho, to un se narm aur adab wali baat kaho, jaise un ke liye kushaada rozi ki dua karo ya unhein wada do ke agar Allah tumhein maal de to tum unhein doge.
29: Aur apna haath kharch karne se na rok, aur kharch karte waqt fizool-kharchi bhi na kar. Agar tu aisa kare to tu apni kanjoosi ki wajah se logon mein malaamat ka haqdaar ho jayega, ya apni fizool-kharchi ki wajah se kharch karne ke qaabil hi na rahega.
30: Aap ka Rubb jis ke liye chahta hai rozi kushaada kar deta hai aur jis ke liye chahta hai tang kar deta hai, aur yeh door tak jaane wali hikmat par hai. Woh apne bandon se khoob khabardar aur unhein dekhne wala hai. Un ka kuch Us se chhipa nahin, aur Woh un ke baare mein apna maamla jaise chahta hai chalata hai.
31: Aur apni aulaad ko is dar se qatl na karo ke agar tum un par kharch karo to aage tangi aa jayegi. Un ki rozi ka zimma Main leta hoon, aur tumhari rozi ka bhi. Unhein qatl karna bada gunah hai, kyunke unhon ne koi jurm nahin kiya aur un ke qatl ki koi wajah nahin.
32: Aur zina se bacho aur un cheezon se bhi door raho jo us ki taraf le jati hain. Woh nihayat gandi baat hai aur chalne ke liye bura raasta hai, kyunke woh nasbon ke milne aur Allah ke azaab tak le jata hai.
33: Aur us jaan ko qatl na karo jise Allah ne iman ya aman ke ahd se mehfooz kar diya hai, siwaye is ke ke qatl haqq ke saath ho, yani baghawat ya qisaas ki buniyaad par. Aur agar koi shaks na-haqq qatl kiya jaye, bina kisi aisi durust wajah ke jo us ke qatl ko jaiz kare, to Maine us ke waris ko, jo us ke maamlaat ka zimmedaar hai, qaatil par kuch ikhtiyar diya hai. Woh maang sakta hai ke qaatil ko qisaas mein qatl kiya jaye, ya use bina kisi badle ke maaf kar de, ya use maaf kar de aur khoon-baha le le. Magar woh qaatil ka muthla na kare, na use kisi aisi cheez se qatl kare jo us ne qatl mein istemaal nahin ki, aur na qaatil ke siwa kisi aur ko qatl kare, chahe woh us ka madadgaar aur saathi hi kyun na ho.
34: Aur us bachche ke maal mein koi len-den na karo jis ka baap mar chuka ho, siwaye us tareeqe se jo us ke faide mein ho, jaise us ko barhana ya use mehfooz rakhna, jab tak woh aql aur samajh ki umar ko na pahunch jaye. Aur apne aur Allah ke darmiyan ya apne aur Us ke bandon ke darmiyan har ahd poora karo, use tode bagair aur us mein kotahi kiye bagair. Allah Qayamat ke din us shaks se poochega jis ne koi ahd kiya: kya us ne use poora kiya, to Woh use ajr dega, ya us ne use poora nahin kiya, to Woh use saza dega.
35: Aur jab doosron ke liye naapo to poora naap do aur unhein dhoka na do. Aur aisi theek tarazoo se tolo jo kisi cheez mein kami na kare aur kisi cheez ki qeemat kam na kare. Poora naap aur poora tol dena tumhare liye duniya aur Aakhirat mein us se behtar hai ke tum naap ya tol mein kami karo.
36: Aur aey Adam (alaihis salaam) ke bete, us cheez ke peeche na chalo jis ka tumhein koi ilm nahin, shubhon aur gumaan ke peeche chal kar. Aadmi se us bhalai ya us burai ke baare mein poocha jayega jis ke liye us ne apne kaan, apni aankh aur apna dil istemaal kiya, aur use bhalai ka ajr aur burai ki saza di jayegi.
37: Aur zameen par gurur aur ghamand se na chalo. Agar tum zameen par akad kar chalo to na tum zameen phaad sakoge aur na tumhara qad buland ho kar pahaadon tak pahunchega. Phir tum itna gurur kyun karte ho?
38: Aey insaan, oopar jo kuch bayan hua us ki burai tumhare Rubb ke nazdeek haraam hai! Allah un logon se raazi nahin jo yeh kaam karte hain, balke Woh unhein sakht na-pasand karta hai.
39: Yeh ahkaam, yeh mumaniat aur yeh qawaid jo Hum ne aap par wazeh kiye, us mein se hain jo aap ke Rubb ne aap par wahi kiya. Aur aey insaan, Allah ke saath koi doosra maabood na bana, warna tum Qayamat ke din Jahannam mein daal diye jaoge, apni jaan aur logon ki malaamat ke saath, aur har bhalai se nikaale hue.
40: Aey woh logo jo daawa karte ho ke farishte Allah ki betiyan hain! Aey mushriko, kya tumhare Rubb ne tumhare liye bete chun liye aur apne liye farishton mein se betiyan le leen? Allah us se bahut buland hai jo tum kehte ho. Tum to Allah ke baare mein ek bahut sangeen baat keh rahe ho ke Us ke liye aulaad thehrate ho aur daawa karte ho ke Us ki betiyan hain, aur apne kufr par ade rehte ho.
41: Aur Maine is Quran mein ahkaam, nasihatein aur misaalein khol kar bayan kein taake log nasihat lein aur us raaste par chalein jo unhein faida de aur use chhod dein jo unhein nuqsan de. Magar haal yeh hai ke un mein se kuch ki fitrat itni bigad chuki hai ke yeh unhein haqq se aur door hi karta hai aur woh us se aur zyada nafrat karne lagte hain.
42: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: agar Allah ke saath doosre maabood hote, jaisa ke woh jhoot ghad kar kehte hain, to woh nam-nihaad maabood Allah tak, jo Arsh ka maalik hai, koi raasta talash karte taake Us se Us ki baadshahat par jhagda aur muqabla karein.
43: Allah, paak hai Woh, us se paak aur mubarra hai jo mushrik Us ki taraf mansoob karte hain, aur Woh un ki baaton se bahut buland hai.
44: Aasman Allah ki paaki bayan karte hain. Zameen Allah ki paaki bayan karti hai. Aasmaano aur zameen ki har makhlooq bhi Allah ki paaki bayan karti hai. Aur koi cheez aisi nahin jo Us ki taarif ke saath Us ki paaki bayan na karti ho, magar tum un ka paaki bayan karne ka tareeqa nahin samajhte. Yeh is liye ke tum sirf un ki tasbeeh samajhte ho jo tumhari zubaan mein karte hain. Woh Burdbaar hai, saza dene mein jaldi nahin karta, aur Woh un logon ke liye Bakhshne wala hai jo Us ki taraf tauba karte hain.
45: Aur aey Rasool, jab aap Quran padhte hain aur woh us ki tambeehein aur us ki nasihatein sunte hain, to Main aap ke aur un logon ke darmiyan jo Qayamat ke din par iman nahin rakhte ek aad daal deta hoon jo unhein Quran samajhne se rokta hai, un ke us se munh modne ki saza ke taur par.
46: Aur Maine un ke dilon par parde daal diye hain taake woh Quran na samjhein, aur un ke kaanon mein bojh daal diya hai taake woh use faide wale tareeqe se na sunein. Aur jab aap Quran mein apne Rubb ka yakta zikr karte hain aur un ke nam-nihaad maaboodon ka zikr nahin karte, to woh ulte paon phir jate hain, Allah ke khaalis yakta hone ko maanne se bahut door.
47: Main khoob jaanta hoon ke un ke sardar Quran kis tarah sunte hain. Woh us se hidayat nahin lena chahte, balke us ka mazaaq udana aur aap ki tilawat mein khalal daalna chahte hain. Aur Main yeh bhi khoob jaanta hoon ke woh chhup kar us ko jhutlane aur doosron ko us se rokne ke baare mein kya mashwara karte hain, jab yeh log, jo apne jhutlane se apni jaanon par zulm karte hain, kehte hain: aey logo, tum to bas ek aise aadmi ke peeche chal rahe ho jis par jaadu kar diya gaya hai aur jo uljhan mein hai.
48: Aey Rasool, gaur kijiye aur taajjub kijiye ke woh aap ko kaisi kaisi malaamat ki sifaton se bayan karte hain. Woh haqq se hat gaye hain aur uljhan mein hain, isi liye woh sachcha raasta nahin paa sakte.
49: Aur mushrikon ne dobara zinda hone ko jhutlate hue kaha: jab hum mar jayenge aur haddiyan ban jayenge aur hamare jism ghul jayenge, to kya hum dobara zinda kiye jayenge? Yeh to na-mumkin hai.
50: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: aey mushriko, agar tum ho sako to paththar jaise sakht ya lohe jaise mazboot ban jao, magar tum kabhi aisa nahin kar sakoge.
51: Ya koi aisi doosri makhlooq ban jao jo in se bhi bari ho, un cheezon mein se jo tumhare dilon mein bari samjhi jati hain. Allah tumhein waise hi lautayega jaise Us ne tumhein pehli baar shuru kiya, aur tumhein waise hi zinda karega jaise Us ne tumhein pehli baar paida kiya. Phir yeh mukhalif kahenge: hamare marne ke baad humein kaun zinda karega? Un se keh dijiye: jis ne tumhein pehli baar bina kisi pehli misaal ke paida kiya, Wohi tumhein lautayega. Phir woh aap ke is jawab ka mazaaq udate hue apne sar hilayenge aur na-maante hue kahenge: yeh lautna kab hoga? Un se keh dijiye: ho sakta hai woh qareeb hi ho, kyunke jo cheez aane wali ho woh jald hi aa jati hai.
52: Allah tumhein us din lautayega jab Woh tumhein hashr ke maidan ki taraf pukarega. Phir tum Us ke hukm ki taabedaari karte hue aur Us ki taarif karte hue Us ko jawab doge, aur tum samjhoge ke tum qabr mein sirf thodi si der hi thehre the.
53: Aey Rasool, mere momin bandon se keh dijiye ke woh baat karte waqt achhi baat kahein aur buri aur na-gawar baaton se bachein, kyunke shaytan un se faida utha kar un ke darmiyan woh cheez phaila deta hai jo un ki duniya aur un ki Aakhirat dono bigaad degi. Be-shak shaytan khula dushman hai, lihaza us se khabardar rehna zaroori hai.
54: Aey logo, tumhara Rubb tumhein khoob jaanta hai. Tumhara kuch Us se chhipa nahin. Agar Woh tum par reham karna chahe to tumhein iman aur neik aamaal se nawaz dega. Aur agar Woh tumhein saza dena chahe to tumhein iman se mehroom karke saza de sakta hai aur tumhein kufr par marne ke liye chhod sakta hai. Aur Us ne Rasool ko logon par daroga bana kar nahin bheja ke woh unhein iman par majboor karein, ya unhein kufr se roken, ya un ke aamaal likhein. Rasool to sirf woh paigham pahunchane wale hain jis ka Allah ne unhein apni taraf se pahunchane ka hukm diya.
55: Aey Rasool, aap ke Rubb ko un sab ka poora ilm hai jo aasmaano aur zameen mein hain, aur Woh un ke haalat aur un ke haqq ko khoob jaanta hai. Aur Maine kuch nabiyon ko doosron par fauqiyat di: zyada pairokaaron se aur un par kitabein utaar kar. Aur Maine Dawood (alaihis salaam) ko apni kitab Zaboor di.
56: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: aey mushriko, jab tumhein koi takleef pahunche to un ko pukaro jinhein tum Allah ke siwa maabood kehte ho. Woh na to tum se takleef hata sakenge aur na use kisi aur ki taraf moad sakenge, apni be-bassi ki wajah se. Aur jo cheez kuch kar hi nahin sakti woh maabood nahin ho sakti.
57: Woh farishte aur doosri hastiyan jinhein yeh pukarte hain, khud aise neik aamaal talash karti hain jo unhein Allah ke qareeb karein, aur ek doosre se aage barhne ki koshish karti hain ke Us ki itaat karke kaun Us ke zyada qareeb ho jaye. Woh umeed rakhti hain ke Woh un par reham kare aur Us ke azaab se darti hain. Aur aey Rasool, aap ke Rubb ka azaab hi woh cheez hai jis se darna chahiye.
58: Aur koi basti ya shehar aisa nahin jis par Main duniya ki is zindagi mein un ke kufr ki wajah se azaab aur halakat na bhejoon, ya use un ke kufr ki wajah se kisi bade azaab mein mubtala na karoon, jaise qatl. Aur yeh halakat aur yeh azaab ek aisa faisla hai jo Lauh-e-Mehfooz mein likha hua hai.
59: Aur Maine woh zaahiri mojize bhejne is liye band kiye jo mushrik maangte hain, jaise murdon ko zinda karna, kyunke Main unhein pichli ummaton ki taraf bhej chuka tha magar unhon ne unhein jhutlaya. Maine Samood ko ek bari aur khuli nishani di thi, yani ountni, magar unhon ne use jhutlaya, to Maine un ka azaab jald kar diya. Aur Main rasoolon ke haathon mojize sirf un ki qaum ko daraane ke liye bhejta hoon, taake woh iman le aayein.
60: Aur aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab Maine aap se kaha: aap ke Rubb ne logon ko apni qudrat se gher rakha hai aur woh Us ke qaaboo mein hain. Allah aap ko un se bachayega, lihaza woh pahuncha dijiye jis ke pahunchane ka aap ko hukm diya gaya. Aur Maine jo kuch aap ko Shab-e-Mairaj mein khul kar dikhaya, woh sirf logon ki aazmaish ke liye tha: kya woh us par iman laate hain ya use jhutlate hain? Aur Maine Zaqqum ke darakht ko, jis ka zikr Quran mein hai ke woh Jahannam ki tah se nikalta hai, sirf un ki aazmaish ke liye banaya. Chunanche agar woh in nishaniyon par iman nahin laate, to woh kisi aur cheez par kabhi iman nahin laayenge. Aur Main unhein nishaniyan bhej kar daraata hoon, magar un se woh sirf apne kufr mein barhte hain aur apni gumraahi mein aur door chale jate hain.
61: Aur aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab Maine farishton se kaha: Adam (alaihis salaam) ko sajda karo, izzat ka sajda, ibadat ka nahin. To unhon ne hukm maana aur sab ne unhein sajda kiya. Magar Iblis ne gurur mein aa kar unhein sajda karne se inkaar kiya aur kaha: kya main us ko sajda karoon jise tu ne mitti se banaya, jab ke tu ne mujhe aag se banaya? Main us se behtar hoon.
62: Iblis ne apne Rubb se kaha: kya tu dekhta hai is makhlooq ko jise tu ne mujh par izzat di aur mujhe hukm diya ke main ise sajda karoon? Agar tu ne mujhe duniya ki zindagi ke aakhir tak zinda rakha, to main is ki aulaad ko bahka doonga aur unhein tere seedhe raaste se gumraah kar doonga, siwaye un chand ke jinhein tu ne bacha liya aur jo tere chune hue bande hain.
63: Us ke Rubb ne us se farmaya: ja, un mein se jo tera kehna maanein un ke saath, kyunke Jahannam tera badla hai aur un ka badla, tumhare aamaal ka poora aur mukammal badla.
64: Aur un mein se jis ko tu bhatka sake apni us aawaz se bhatka le jo nafarmani ki taraf bulati hai, aur un par apne sawaron aur apne piyaadon se chadhai kar jo teri itaat ki taraf bulate hain, aur un ke maal mein un ka sharik ban ja: har us kaam ko khoobsurat kar dikha kar jo shariat ke khilaaf hai. Aur un ki aulaad mein bhi un ka sharik ban ja: un par jhoota daawa karke, unhein zina se haasil karke, aur unhein Allah ka naam lete waqt Allah ke siwa doosron ki ibadat par laga kar. Aur unhein jhoote wade aur be-kaar umeedein khoobsurat kar dikha. Aur shaytan sirf aise jhoote wade karta hai jo unhein dhoke mein daalte hain.
65: Aey Iblis, Mere un momin bandon par tera koi zor nahin jo Meri itaat mein amal karte hain, kyunke Allah ne un se teri burai hata di hai. Aur Allah us shaks ke liye kaar-saaz ke taur par kaafi hai jo apne kaamon mein Usi par bharosa karta hai.
66: Aey logo, tumhara Rubb wahi hai jo tumhare liye samundar mein kashtiyan chalata hai, is umeed par ke tum tijarat ke nafe waghairah se apni rozi talash karo. Woh tum par Meharban hai ke Us ne tumhare liye yeh zariye aasan kar diye.
67: Aur aey mushriko, jab tumhein samundar mein koi aisi museebat ya koi aisi aafat pesh aati hai jis se tumhein halak hone ka dar ho, to woh sab tumhare zehan se nikal jate hain jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibadat karte ho, aur tum sirf Allah ko yaad karte ho aur Usi se madad maangte ho. Phir jab Woh tumhari madad karta hai aur tumhein tumhare khauf se bacha leta hai aur tum khushki par laut aate ho, to tum Us ke yakta hone aur sirf Usi ko pukarne se munh mod lete ho aur apne buton ki taraf laut jate ho. Aur insaan Allah ki naimaton ka bada na-shukra hai.
68: Phir aey mushriko, kya tum is se mehfooz ho gaye ho ke jab Allah tumhein salaamati ke saath khushki par pahuncha de to Woh use tum samet dhansa na de? Ya kya tum is se mehfooz ho gaye ho ke Woh tum par paththaron ki baarish na barsa de jaise Us ne Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ke saath kiya? Phir tum koi kaar-saaz nahin paaoge jo tumhari hifazat kare aur na koi madadgaar jo tumhein halak hone se bachaye.
69: Ya kya tum is se mehfooz ho gaye ho ke Allah tumhein doosri baar samundar mein wapas le jaye, phir tum par ek tez hawa bheje aur tumhein dubo de, tumhari us na-shukri ki wajah se jo tum ne Allah ki naimaton par ki, is ke baad ke Us ne tumhein pehli baar bacha liya tha? Phir tum Us ke khilaaf koi daawa karne wala nahin paaoge jo tumhare saath Us ke kiye par tumhara bachaav kare.
70: Aur Maine Adam (alaihis salaam) ki aulaad ko aql se izzat di, aur farishton se un ke baap ko sajda karwaya, aur un ke liye woh jaanwar aur woh sawaariyan kaam par laga deen jo unhein khushki par le kar chalti hain, aur woh kashtiyan bhi jo unhein samundar par le kar chalti hain. Aur Maine unhein achha khana, achha peena, joode aur doosri cheezein deen, aur Maine unhein apni bahut si makhlooq par bari fazeelat di. Lihaza unhein chahiye ke Allah ki apne oopar naimaton par Us ka shukr ada karein.
71: Aur aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab har giroh ko us ke us sardar ke naam se pukara jayega jis ke peeche woh duniya mein chalta tha. Phir jis ko us ke aamaal ki kitab us ke daayein haath mein di jayegi, woh apni kitabein khushi se padhenge. Aur un ke ajr mein se zarra bhar kami nahin ki jayegi, khajoor ki gutli ke dhaage ke barabar bhi nahin.
72: Aur jis ka dil duniya ki is zindagi mein haqq maanne aur us ke saamne jhukne se andha raha, woh Qayamat ke din zyada andha hoga, Jannat ke raaste ki hidayat nahin paayega, aur hidayat se zyada bhatka hua hoga. Aur badla amal ke barabar hi hoga.
73: Aur aey Rasool, mushrik qareeb the ke aap ko us Quran se hata dein jo Maine aap par utara, taake aap Mere naam par koi aur cheez ghad lein jo un ki khwahishon ke mutabiq ho. Aur agar aap woh karte jo woh chahte the, to woh aap ko apna gehra dost bana lete.
74: Aur agar Main aap par yeh ehsan na karta ke aap ko haqq par jamaye rakha, to aap qareeb the ke un ki taraf thoda sa jhuk jate aur phir un ki us baat par raazi ho jate jo unhon ne aap se maangi, un ke shadeed dhoke aur un ki chaalon ki wajah se, aur is ke saath aap ki is shadeed chaahat ki wajah se ke woh iman le aayein. Magar Maine aap ko un ki taraf jhukne se bacha liya.
75: Aur agar aap un ki maangi hui baat mein un ki taraf jhuk jate, to Main aap ko is duniya mein aur Aakhirat mein kai guna azaab deta, phir aap koi madadgaar na paate jo Mere muqable mein aap ki madad kare aur aap se azaab hataye.
76: Aur kafir qareeb the ke aap ko apni dushmani ki wajah se tang karke Makkah se nikaal dein. Magar Allah ne unhein aap ko nikaalne se rok diya, yahan tak ke aap ne khud apne Rubb ke hukm se hijrat ki. Aur agar woh aap ko nikaal dete, to woh aap ko nikaalne ke baad sirf thodi muddat hi baaqi rehte.
77: Un ka aap ke baad sirf thodi muddat baaqi rehna aap se pehle ke rasoolon ke saath Allah ka hamesha ka dastoor hai, yani yeh ke jab bhi kisi rasool ko us ki qaum ne nikaala, Allah ne un par azaab bhej diya. Aur aey Rasool, aap Mere dastoor mein koi tabdeeli nahin paayenge, balke aap use jama hua aur qayam paayenge.
78: Namaz qayam kijiye: use apne waqton mein sab se mukammal tareeqe se ada karke, aur woh waqt sooraj ka aasman ke darmiyan se dhalne se shuru hote hain, jis mein zuhr aur asr ki namazein hain, raat ke andhere tak, jis mein maghrib aur isha ki namazein hain. Aur fajr ki namaz qayam kijiye aur us mein tilawat lambi kijiye, kyunke fajr ki namaz mein raat ke farishte aur din ke farishte dono haazir hote hain.
79: Aur aey Rasool, raat ke kuch hisse mein uth kar namaz padhiye, taake aap ki namaz aap ka darja barhaye, aur apne Rubb se yeh maangiye ke Woh aap ko Qayamat ke din maqaam-e-mahmood par uthaye: ke aap Qayamat ke din ki haulnaakiyon se logon ke liye sifarish karne wale hon, aur aap ko shafaat-e-kubra ka muqaam mile, jis par pehle aur baad ke sab log aap ki taarif karenge.
80: Aur aey Rasool, keh dijiye: aey mere Rubb, mera har daakhil hona aur har nikalna teri itaat mein aur teri razamandi ke liye bana de. Aur mujhe apni taraf se ek khuli daleel de jis se tu mere dushman ke khilaaf meri madad kare.
81: Aur aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: Islam aa gaya, woh madad sach ho gayi jis ka Allah ne wada kiya tha, aur shirk aur kufr chala gaya. Be-shak baatil jaane wala hai aur mit jayega, woh haqq ke saamne tik nahin sakta.
82: Aur Main Quran mein woh utarta hoon jo dilon ko na-waaqfiyat, kufr aur shak se shifa deta hai, jo badan ko shifa deta hai jab us se ilaaj kiya jaye, aur jo un mominon ke liye rehmat hai jo us par amal karte hain. Aur yeh Quran kafiron ko sirf barbaadi mein barhata hai, kyunke use sunna unhein gussa dilata hai aur unhein aur zyada jhutlane aur us se munh modne par le jata hai.
83: Aur jab Main insaan ko koi naimat deta hoon, jaise sehat aur maal, to woh Allah ka shukr ada karne aur Us ki itaat karne se munh mod leta hai, aur gurur mein aur door chala jata hai. Magar jab use beemari, tangi ya is tarah ki koi cheez pesh aati hai, to woh Allah ki rehmat se shadeed mayoos aur na-umeed ho jata hai.
84: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: har aadmi us raaste par amal karta hai jo hidayat ya gumraahi mein us ke apne haal se milta hai. Magar aap ka Rubb khoob jaanta hai ke haqq ki taraf sab se zyada hidayat-yaafta kaun hai.
85: Aey Rasool, ahl-e-kitab ke kafir aap se rooh ki haqeeqat ke baare mein poochte hain. Un se keh dijiye: rooh mere Rubb ke hukm mein se hai. Aur jo ilm tumhein aur Allah ki tamam makhlooq ko diya gaya hai woh Allah ke ilm ke muqable mein bahut thoda hai.
86: Allah ki qasam, aey Rasool, agar Main chahoon ke woh wahi aap se le loon jo Maine aap par utari, use dilon aur kitabon se mita kar, to Main use le sakta hoon, phir aap koi nahin paayenge jo aap ki madad kare aur use wapas laane ka zimma le.
87: Magar Maine use nahin liya, aap ke Rubb ki taraf se rehmat ke taur par, aur Maine use mehfooz rehne diya. Be-shak aap par aap ke Rubb ka fazl bada hai, ke Us ne aap ko Rasool banaya, aap par nabiyon ka silsila khatam kiya, aur aap par Quran utara.
88: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: agar tamam insaan aur jinn mil kar is Quran jaisa koi kalaam laane ki koshish karein jo aap par utara gaya, us ki fasahat, us ki umda tarteeb aur us ke paak andaaz mein, to woh is jaisa kuch kabhi nahin laa sakenge, chahe woh sab ek doosre ki madad aur ek doosre ka saath hi kyun na dein.
89: Aur Maine is Quran mein logon ke liye khol kar bayan kiya aur har tarah ki nasihatein, yaad-dihaaniyan, ahkaam, mumaniat aur woh qisse laaya jin se woh sabaq le sakein, is umeed par ke woh iman laayein. Magar aksar logon ne is Quran ko jhutlane ke siwa har cheez se inkaar kar diya.
90: Aur mushrikon ne kaha: hum tum par kabhi iman nahin laayenge jab tak tum hamare liye Makkah ki zameen se koi aisa chashma na nikaalo jo behna band na kare.
91: Ya tumhara koi aisa baagh ho jis mein bahut se phool hon aur jis mein tum kasrat se nahrein chalao.
92: Ya tum aasman ko hum par gira do, jaisa tum ne kaha, azaab ke tukdon ki soorat mein, ya tum Allah aur farishton ko hamare saamne saaf saamne le aao taake woh tumhare daawe ki sachhaai par gawahi dein.
93: Ya tumhara koi aisa ghar ho jo sone aur doosri cheezon se saja hua ho, ya tum aasman par chadh jao. Aur agar tum us par chadh bhi jao to hum tab tak yaqeen nahin karenge ke tum bheje gaye ho jab tak tum Allah ki taraf se likhi hui koi kitab le kar na utro jis mein hum padh sakein ke tum Allah ke Rasool ho. Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: mera Rubb paak hai, main to sirf ek insaan rasool hoon, baaqi tamam rasoolon ki tarah. Mere bas mein nahin ke main koi cheez laa doon, phir main woh kaise laa sakta hoon jo tum ne maanga?
94: Aur kafiron ko Allah aur Us ke rasoolon par iman laane aur Rasool ki laayi hui baat par amal karne se sirf is baat ne roka ke woh yeh maanne ko tayyar nahin the ke koi rasool insaan ho sakta hai, aur unhon ne jhutlate hue kaha: kya Allah ne insaano mein se ek rasool bhej diya?
95: Aey Rasool, un ke jawab mein keh dijiye: agar zameen par farishte hote jo us mein rehte aur aman se chalte phirte, jaisa tumhara haal hai, to Hum un ki taraf un hi ki jins mein se ek farishta rasool bhejte, kyunke wahi unhein woh baat samjha sakta jis ke saath woh bheja gaya. Un ki taraf insaan rasool bhejna hikmat ke khilaaf hota, aur isi tarah tumhara maamla bhi hai.
96: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: Allah mere aur tumhare darmiyan gawah ke taur par kaafi hai ke main rasool bana kar tumhari taraf bheja gaya hoon aur maine woh pahuncha diya jis ke saath main tumhari taraf bheja gaya. Be-shak Woh apne bandon ke haalat ko ghere hue hai, un ka kuch Us se chhipa nahin, aur Woh un ki jaanon ke tamam bhed dekhta hai.
97: Aur jise Allah hidayat ki taufeeq de, wahi sach-much hidayat par hai. Aur jise Woh us se hata de aur gumraah kar de, aey Rasool, aap un ke liye koi kaar-saaz kabhi nahin paayenge jo unhein haqq ki hidayat dein, un se nuqsan hatayein aur unhein faida pahunchayein. Aur Main unhein Qayamat ke din is haal mein jama karoonga ke woh apne chehron ke bal ghaseete jayenge, na dekhte honge, na bolte honge aur na sunte honge. Un ka thikana, jis ki taraf woh jayenge, Jahannam hai. Jab bhi us ke shole dhime padne lagenge, Main use aur bhadka doonga.
98: Woh azaab jis se un ka saamna hoga un ki Meri un nishaniyon ko jhutlane ki wajah se un ka badla hai jo Maine apne rasoolon ke saath bheji, aur is wajah se ke unhon ne dobara zinda hone ko door ki baat samajh kar kaha: jab hum mar jayenge aur ghuli hui haddiyan aur bikhri hui zarrat ban jayenge, to kya hum is ke baad ek nayi makhlooq bana kar dobara zinda kiye jayenge?
99: Kya dobara zinda hone ko jhutlane wale yeh log nahin jaante ke Allah, jis ne aasman paida kiye aur jis ne zameen paida ki, un ki azmat ke baawajood, un jaison ko paida karne par qaadir hai? Chunanche jo kisi bari cheez ko paida karne par qaadir hai woh us se chhoti cheez ko paida karne par bhi qaadir hai. Aur Allah ne un ke liye is duniya mein ek muqarrar waqt rakha hai jis mein un ki umrein khatam hongi, aur un ke dobara zinda hone ka ek waqt rakha hai jis mein koi shak nahin. Magar dobara zinda hone ki dalilein saaf hone ke baawajood mushrik use jhutlane ke siwa har cheez se inkaar karte hain.
100: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: agar tumhare paas mere Rubb ke woh khazane hote jo kabhi ghat-te aur khatam nahin hote, to tum unhein kharch karne se ruk jate, is dar se ke woh ghat jayenge yahan tak ke tum gareeb ho jaoge. Aur insaan ki fitrat mein kanjoosi hai, siwaye us ke jo momin ho aur Allah ke ajr ki umeed mein kharch kare.
101: Aur Maine Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko nau khuli dalilein deen jo un ki gawahi deti theen. Woh laathi, haath, qeht, phalon ki kami, toofan, tiddiyan, joonein, mendhak aur khoon thin. Aey Rasool, Yahudiyon se poochiye ke jab Moosa yeh mojize un ke bade-buzurgon ke paas laaye to Firaunhon ne kaha: aey Moosa, main tumhein ek aisa aadmi samajhta hoon jis par jaadu ho chuka hai, kyunke tum ajeeb cheezein laate ho.
102: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne us ke jawab mein kaha: aey Firaun, tu yaqeen se jaanta hai ke yeh nishaniyan us Allah ke siwa kisi ne nahin bheji jo aasmaano aur zameen ka Rubb hai. Us ne unhein apni qudrat aur apne rasool ki sachhaai ki dalilein bana kar bheja. Magar tu ne jhutlaya. Aur aey Firaun, main jaanta hoon ke tu halak hone wala aur ghaate mein padne wala hai.
103: Chunanche Firaunhon ne irada kiya ke Moosa (alaihis salaam) aur un ki qaum ko Misr se nikaal kar saza de, to Maine use aur us ke saath ke tamam lashkaron ko dubo kar halak kar diya.
104: Aur Maine Firaun aur us ke lashkaron ko halak karne ke baad Bani Israel se kaha: Shaam ki sarzameen mein baso. Phir jab Qayamat ka din aayega, to Main tum sab ko hisaab ke liye hashr ke maidan mein le aaoonga.
105: Aur Maine Quran ko haqq ke saath Muhammad ﷺ par utara, aur woh haqq ke saath hi un par utara, bina kisi tabdeeli aur bina kisi chhed-chhaad ke. Aur aey Rasool, Maine aap ko sirf is liye bheja ke aap muttaqiyon ko Jannat ki khush-khabri dein aur kafiron aur gunahgaron ko Jahannam se daraayein.
106: Aur Maine use aisa Quran bana kar bheja jise Maine alag alag kiya aur khol kar bayan kiya, is umeed par ke aap use logon ko theher theher kar aur gaur se padh kar sunayein, kyunke yeh samajhne aur gaur karne ke liye zyada moassar hai. Aur Maine use waqiyat aur haalat ke mutabiq alag alag hisson mein utara.
107: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: us par iman laao, kyunke tumhara iman us mein kuch izafa nahin karega, ya us par iman na laao, kyunke tumhara kufr us mein kuch kami nahin karega. Be-shak jo log pichli aasmani kitabein padhte hain aur jinhon ne wahi aur nabuwwat ko samjha, jab un ke saamne Quran padha jata hai to woh apne chehron ke bal gir padte hain aur shukr mein Allah ko sajda karte hain.
108: Aur woh apne sajde mein kehte hain: hamara Rubb kabhi apna wada nahin todega. Us ne Muhammad ﷺ ke bhejne ka jo wada kiya woh zaroor poora hoga. Be-shak hamare Rubb ka is baare mein aur baaqi maamlaat mein kiya hua wada zaroor poora hoga.
109: Aur woh apne chehron ke bal gir padte hain, Allah ko sajda karte hue aur Us ke khauf se rote hue. Aur Quran sunna aur us ke maani par gaur karna unhein Allah ke saamne jhukne aur Us se darne mein barha deta hai.
110: Aey Rasool, un logon se keh dijiye jo aap par is par aib lagate hain ke aap 'aey Allah, aey Rehman' keh kar dua karte hain: Allah aur Rehman Usi ke naam hain, lihaza Use in mein se kisi naam se ya Us ke doosre naamon se pukaro. Us ke tamam naam khoobsurat hain aur yeh dono un hi mein se hain, lihaza Use in dono se ya Us ke doosre khoobsurat naamon se pukaro. Aur apni namaz mein buland aawaz se tilawat na kijiye, kahin mushrik aap ko sun na lein, aur itni dheemi aawaz se bhi na kijiye ke momin sun na sakein, balke in dono ke darmiyan ka raasta chuniye.
111: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: tamam taarif Allah hi ke liye hai jo har tarah ki taarif ka haqdaar hai aur jo is se buland hai ke Us ki koi aulaad ya koi sharik ho, chunanche Us ki baadshahat mein Us ka koi sharik nahin. Aur Us par na koi zillat aati hai aur na koi kamzori, is liye Use kisi aise ki zaroorat nahin jo Us ki madad aur Us ka saath de. Lihaza Us ki bahut bahut azmat bayan kijiye, aur Us ke liye na koi aulaad thehraiye, na koi sharik, aur na koi madadgaar ya koi saathi.
